sentences.en: The disease we are talking about is hereditary.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的这种疾病是遗传性的。

sentences.en: Cousin marriage increases the risk of hereditary disease.
sentences.zh: 近亲结婚会增加遗传性疾病的风险。

sentences.en: Hereditary Prince Alois is the regent of Liechtenstein.
sentences.zh: 世袭王子阿洛伊斯是列支敦士登的摄政王。

senses.zh: 遗传的；世袭的；世代相传的
